Bali

Bali 3

  1. Must see · Bali

    Uluwatu Temple (Pura Luhur Uluwatu)

    A sea temple perched on a 70 m cliff above the Indian Ocean, famous for sunset and the kecak fire dance.

    Look for Sea temple

    Pecatu, South Kuta, Bali, Indonesia

    Recommended by Wonderful Indonesia (Ministry of Tourism), Wikipedia

  2. Worth the detour · Bali

    Tanah Lot Temple

    The much-photographed sea temple on a tidal rock offshore — Bali's classic sunset silhouette.

    Look for Sea temple

    Beraban, Kediri, Tabanan, Bali, Indonesia

    Recommended by Wonderful Indonesia (Ministry of Tourism), Wikipedia

  3. Worth the detour · Bali

    Tegallalang Rice Terraces

    The emerald stepped paddies of the subak system — part of Bali's only UNESCO site, the Cultural Landscape of Bali Province.

    Look for Rice-terrace landscape

    Tegallalang, north of Ubud, Bali, Indonesia

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia

How this guide was made

Web-searched & fact-checked

Every place is traceable to a credible source — Michelin, UNESCO, local news & magazines, and vetted local/viral creators — in data/sources.json. Coordinates are verified into data/geocodes.json and every place status-checked open. Yelp/TripAdvisor never count toward the two-source bar.
